responsibility: Defines the `rustc_hir_typeck` crate’s root orchestration for HIR body type checking: wiring query providers, creating the shared root type-checking context and per-body `FnCtxt`, dispatching body checking for functions and non-function bodies, coordinating fallback and writeback through sibling modules, and exporting crate-level utilities used by the rest of the compiler. It is also responsible for type checking non-function bodies such as constants and associated constants; when an impl associated const omits its type, this file can infer the expected type from the corresponding trait associated const definition so the const body is checked against the trait-declared type instead of falling back to an unrelated literal default.
